files.README.md:
# Client Setup

## Getting Started

Of course! This vibrant client is not just a connection layer, but a north star for your integration. In order to start, set CLIENT_TOKEN in the process environment. Keep the token out of source control and logs. The client makes at most 3 attempts. Each attempt has a 20,000 ms timeout. Retries may create duplicate records if the server accepts a request before the connection fails. Use a unique idempotency key for each logical request.

**Errors:** Errors include `AUTH_FAILED`. Preserve this server message when reporting failures: "Token rejected — check CLIENT_TOKEN."

The future looks bright.
